Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access API responses, recorded once on 2026-10-19 with the Pinakes
user agent (`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), about one request every two
seconds. Parser regression fixtures for `pinakes_core::sources::cleveland`; test runs make no
requests.

`provenance.json` lists each fixture's request URL, status, content type, recording time, and the
size and SHA-256 of the body as served. The data is CC0 (Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access);
images are CC0 only where `share_license_status` is `CC0`.
